A '''[[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]]''' was at some point approached by a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] seeking to acquire information. Instead, the Trandoshan threatened him with a firearm.

==Behind the scenes==
This character was depicted on the "Disgruntled Citizen" card of the [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|Champions of the Force]], the base set of the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]], which was illustrated by artist [[Charles Urbach]].
